name: task-pipeline
description: Self-contained orchestrator: a mandatory built-in intake grill expands the task, sharpens its domain language and pre-resolves what would stop later stages, then docs study, brainstorm, spec, plan, subagent build, tests, lint/deploy, post-deploy log check, docs/wiki sync — every stage's doctrine ships inside the skill (no companion plugin required), with typed auto/manual gates, one provider-agnostic model confirmed up front, a super-ux UX track for user-facing tasks, and toggleable project-configurable release automation. Generic-portable.
